activities.summary: Flagged as the REGULATOR, not a commercial prospect. It arrived via a GLEIF name sweep for UAE banks, which cannot tell a central bank from a commercial one — GLEIF carries no industry classification. Kept because central banks do procure treasury and reserve-management systems, but labelled so nobody treats it as an ordinary lead.

description: The UAE's central bank and financial regulator. ⚠ NOT a commercial-bank prospect: it is the supervisor of most other records in this market. It is kept because a central bank genuinely does buy portfolio, treasury and reserve-management systems and procures them formally — but it must never be worked as if it were a commercial bank, and anything said to it is said to our markets' regulator.
name: CENTRAL BANK OF THE UAE

source.detail: GLEIF LEI 5493006P6LOOFH8TB150, entity status ACTIVE, legal address ABU DHABI. ⚠ Sourced from GLEIF because the Central Bank of the UAE's own register is bot-protected and returns 403 to an honestly-identified client — a bank we cannot enumerate is a bank whose RFP we cannot watch for, so the identity graph was used as the substitute instrument. GLEIF carries NO industry classification: the segment here is inferred from the legal name and must be confirmed before this record is worked.
